video_title: Boogie - Lakers Are WORSE if They Resign LeBron & Reaves!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James has earned the right to demand what he wants
quotes.excerpt: I think LeBron is LeBron. I think he's earned every right to demand whatever he wants.
quotes.quote: This has nothing to do with what he's produced on the court. I think LeBron is LeBron. I think he's earned every right to demand whatever he wants. It's more so just about treating him correctly as this story comes to an end, and that's more so what I'm worried about. I'm not necessarily sure that the Lakers will do it the right way. You've heard the rumblings, you've heard the rumors. They may not necessarily want him back, they may want him back regardless. This is LeBron James we're talking about, and to even have that type of chatter surrounded around his name, I take it as disrespect.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers and Cavaliers are the only realistic landing spots for LeBron
quotes.excerpt: To me it's either Lakers or Cleveland. Can you imagine him going to like...
quotes.quote: If I'm the Lakers, yes. If I'm LeBron, maybe I'm a little hesitant, but all those comments, those were from the former owner. To me it's either Lakers or Cleveland. Can you imagine him going to like, it's going to be one of those two teams. And this is a team, by the way, that finished fourth in the Western Conference that was absolutely loaded. They finished higher than the Rockets, higher than the Timberwolves. They had a really good year. So now we're getting to the summer and we're talking about the decisions they have to make.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's pay cut sets a new standard for championship contenders
quotes.excerpt: With what Jalen Brunson has done this season, and everything that kind of rolled into it.
quotes.quote: With what Jalen Brunson has done this season, and everything that kind of rolled into it as far as him taking a pay cut to get his guys in, and then it eventually leads to a championship, I think a lot of teams are going to be looking at guys. If you're really serious about competing for a championship, we're expecting you to make some type of sacrifice, and they're going to always use Jalen Brunson as an example of that. I can definitely see teams moving forward throwing that in players' faces on max guys' faces, saying, if you're really about a championship, show us.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's sacrifice sets a difficult precedent for other stars
quotes.excerpt: Teams going into free agency, they're going to use this as an example where Jalen Brunson just ruined the whole game.
quotes.quote: Teams going into free agency, they're going to use this as an example where Jalen Brunson just ruined the whole game. It's like free agency, the first guy that takes less to go back, damn, I'm telling my agent like, now that's my number. Jalen Brunson just set the tone to show, look how unselfish I was and it paid off for a championship. That's definitely going to be in teams' pitches. And I see both sides. Now LeBron James, I'm not a big pay cut guy. I would, I never did it my career, it wasn't my thing. LeBron James is damn near a billionaire. If there's one guy in the NBA that could do it and not hurt at all, it's him.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James taking a max contract would hurt the Lakers' roster
quotes.excerpt: If he takes max, this team ain't going to be very good next year.
quotes.quote: If he's truly about winning and truly wants to surround himself with pieces and be able to acquire and go get the Trey Murphys of the world and give Austin Reaves the contract he deserves and have this, go add these pieces like a Herb Jones, then he's going to have to take a pay cut. If he takes max, this team ain't going to be very good next year.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' playoff performance doesn't warrant a max contract
quotes.excerpt: Based off your question as far as what I seen in the playoffs, no.
quotes.quote: Based off your question as far as what I seen in the playoffs, no. And when you think about a max guy, this is a guy that's going to take me over the hump. This is a guy I can lean on every single night. I can depend on every night and I know he's carrying my team every night.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' stats make him a candidate for a large contract
quotes.excerpt: If I just gave you those blind stats, you would be like, that dude's getting paid this summer.
quotes.quote: But based on 24, 6 and 5 on 50% shooting and 36 from the three, if I just gave you those blind stats, you would be like, that dude's getting paid this summer. So if I'm Austin Reaves, I'm saying the same thing, kiss my ass. I deserve my money, like pay me or I'm going somewhere else. And he's in no, he's damn sure in no position to take a pay cut. He absolutely should go get his money. I don't care where that is, like he should go get paid.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers will struggle to improve if they retain current core
quotes.excerpt: I think they get worse, and the reason I say that, obviously you're adding more money to the books.
quotes.quote: I think they get worse, and the reason I say that, obviously you're adding more money to the books, so it'll be harder to kind of surround them with the talent necessary to be better or to compete. And then on top of that, I believe everybody in the West is getting better. So when you put those two components together, I just don't really see a recipe for success with the Lakers moving forward this season with that three-headed monster.
